rv.q: Only here, in the fictional Yorkshire Dales village of Knapely, would Cheshire seem snooty and crazy paving seem outre. Another great quality is its understanding of community. Sure, it makes fun of the jam-and-knitting conservatism of the Women’s Institute, but deep down it is wiser than that.
Yorkshire homecoming for Gary Barlow and Tim Firth’s hug of a musical is irresistibly lovely
